item.description:
Madonna - The Complete Promotional Single (2026) Directory

To make things easier for everyone, I've created a directory containing Madonna promotional single in different mix. Feel free to browse, download, and enjoy the collection.

Source:

Some of the tracks were extracted directly from Madonna's official singles, EPs, album, (Qobuz, Hi-Res, Apple Music, Physical & Radio Rip) then organized into a single collection.

All cover artwork was recreated by me.
